description: Returns one legal act of the Legislative Herald (matsne.gov.ge) by its identifier from law_search_acts. With no article, returns the metadata, the newest 20 consolidated versions with their publication dates, the count of every version, and the table of contents. With articles, returns the full text of at most 10 articles, for example 82 or 133^3 (article 133 with the superscript 3). Give a version number or a date to read the act as it stood then; the default is the newest version, or in English the newest translated version. A version date is its publication date, not the date it took effect. The Georgian text is the only official text; an English text is a translation, and not every act has one. Data from the Legislative Herald of Georgia.

articles.description: At most 10 article numbers, for example 82 or 133^3. Leave empty for the table of contents.

date.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD. Reads the newest version published on or before it.

id.description: The identifier of the act from law_search_acts, for example 1043717.

language.description: The language of the text: ka or en. The default is en. Only ka is official.

piece.description: For an act with no articles: the piece of 50,000 characters of its text, from 1. The default is 1.

version.description: A version number from the versions of the act, from 0. Give a version or a date, not both.

name: law_get_act

articles.description: The requested articles, in the order of the act.

paragraphs.description: The paragraphs of the article as published, with the notes of each amendment.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the act, RFC 3339.

contents.description: The sections, chapters, and articles, in order. Only when no article is requested.

number.description: The number, for example IV or 133^3.

issuer.description: The body that adopted the act.

newest_version.description: The newest version of the act, when it is newer than this text. A translation can trail the Georgian text.

date.description: The publication date of the version, YYYY-MM-DD.

next_article.description: The first requested article left out by the size limit. Ask for it in a new call.

notice.description: Set for a translation: only the Georgian text is official.

official.description: True for the Georgian text. False for a translation.

piece.description: The piece of the text, from 1.

pieces.description: The count of pieces of the text.

registration_code.description: The registration code of the act.

source.description: The source of the data: Legislative Herald of Georgia.

stale.description: True when the source did not answer and the server returns a text it read before.

status.description: active, expired, or pending. Empty when the source gives none.

text.description: The text of an act that has no articles: one piece.

truncated.description: True when one article passed the size limit and its last paragraphs are left out.

type.description: The document type as the source names it.

url.description: The page of this version at the Legislative Herald.

date.description: The publication date of the version, YYYY-MM-DD.

version_count.description: The count of every version of the act. Give a version or a date to read an older one.

versions.description: The newest 20 versions, newest first. Only when no article is requested.

date.description: The publication date of the version, YYYY-MM-DD.

title: Get a legal act of Georgia
